name: subtitle-studio
description: Local-first subtitle creation and editing. Root scripts orchestrate the frontend and backend.

scripts.lint: pnpm --dir frontend lint && uv run --directory backend ruff check . && uv run --directory backend ruff format --check .
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir frontend typecheck && uv run --directory backend mypy
scripts.test: pnpm --dir frontend test && uv run --directory backend pytest -q
